**Warning: This endpoint is currently only available for non-pii tenants.**
Retrieves a mapping of existing customer profiles given a list of profile emails. 
Any emails provided that are not associated with a Customer Profile, will not be part of the mapping returned.

**Notes:**   
For profiles created before Jan 6th 2022 there is no uniqueness guarantee for the email. This means that for some tenants the mapping returned
from this endpoint may be a bigger set than the emails requested.
